paragraphs: Rav Gamda. Rav Ashi said, “Thus said Rav Gamda in the name of Rava”: Bava Kamma 72a. He stated his teaching to Rav Ashi: there, 106, end of side a. Amemar, Mar Zutra, and Rav Zevid: Ketubbot 63, end of side b. He said to them, “But did not Rav Kahana say that Rava posed this question and did not resolve it?” “In the name of Rav”: Beitzah 7, end of side a. From this, it seems to me, arose Sheerit Yosef’s error in counting him among Rav’s students. But he is mistaken; it should read “in the name of Rava.” The newer Talmud editions did not correct it.
